description: a few loose strands of thread and textile fibre, lying free
a single dried print of a boot sole pressed in mud, the crust cracked and flaking at its edges, the tread pattern still legible in the ridges
a small cast-iron ventilation grille, rectangular, with narrow horizontal slats and two countersunk screw holes; one slat is bent slightly out of line
a short length of coarse three-strand hemp rope, one section flattened and burnished smooth, loose fibres fuzzed up along that worn stretch
a loose heap of fine powdery ash mixed with small brittle charred flakes, several flakes still holding a curled shape
a pocket watch, a bone comb, a single leather glove and three loose coins arranged as one coherent group
a plain wooden side chair, spindle-backed, seat worn pale in the middle, standing empty
two loose sheets of thin writing paper covered in even lines of illegible ink handwriting, laid one overlapping the other, edges slightly curled
a short stack of banknotes with a scatter of coins beside it, the notes crisp and unfolded, the coins bright and unworn
a small brass hand lantern with a squared glass housing, the glass clouded with soot, wire bail handle folded down, wick trimmed short
a servants' bell board — a long varnished wooden panel carrying a row of small brass bells on coiled springs, each with a small blank plate beneath
a plain peaked uniform cap of dark serge with a stiff leather brim and a bare metal badge plate, the crown creased from wear
a thick account ledger lying open, ruled into narrow columns filled with small illegible handwritten marks, one line scraped thin and written over in darker ink, cloth spine frayed at the head
a sheet of thin writing paper torn into several pieces, the ragged edges resting loosely back together, close lines of illegible ink handwriting running across the breaks
a stiff card railway ticket torn in half along a ragged edge, printed with dense illegible marks, a punched hole clipped through one corner, the surface softened and furred from a pocket
a large folded certificate of heavy paper, printed with fine engraved scrollwork and ruled blank lines, creased in three where it was folded, a disc of red wax pressed at the foot
a small apothecary vial of dark glass with a ground glass stopper, a dried residue ring left around the inside of the shoulder, no label
an open-faced pocket watch with a plain enamel dial and slender hands, the case scratched and the bow worn thin, chain absent
two narrow slips of paper bearing lines of illegible ink handwriting, laid one above the other as one comparison group, the pen strokes pressed hard enough to emboss the paper
a small scrap of paper charred brittle and black around every edge, the surface flaked away in patches, faint impressed pen strokes still raised across what remains
